title: Kitchen Lab recipe evidence
scope: Illustrative recipe simulation; not a validated predictor of real cooking temperatures or times. Written explanations require human review.

cooks.title: Rescue a dry sauce

criteria.label: Sauce adjusted to coat the pasta and mixed through
Dish checked after adjustment; both burners off

cooks.scope: Prepared starting dish supplied by the challenge. Only the following rescue actions belong to the learner.

rescue.brief: Golden mushroom pasta is already combined, but the sauce looks dry. Both burners are off; the pan is still warm. You have 200 mL of saved pasta water.

explanations.question: Which change addresses the starting problem, and why?
explanations.answer: A measured splash adds moisture; folding distributes it through the dish.

findings.label: Sauce adjusted to coat the pasta and mixed through
findings.observation: 8 mL starting moisture → 58 mL at finish. Golden, glossy mushrooms. 0 mL saved water added since the last mix.

findings.label: Pasta retains a slight bite
findings.observation: Provided pasta began with a slight bite. Finished texture: Tender with a slight bite.
findings.nextPractice: Keep watching the pasta while adjusting the sauce.

findings.label: Dish checked after adjustment; both burners off
findings.observation: The dish was checked after the last adjustment.
findings.nextPractice: Check the dish after the last change and turn both burners off.

timeline.event: Pour a measured amount of saved water
timeline.observation: 50 mL cooking water poured; 150 mL remains in the jug. Observe the sauce, then decide whether it needs another splash.

timeline.event: Mix with a complete pan sweep
timeline.observation: Pasta folded through the sauce. Observe the coating before deciding on another splash. Check the dish again before plating.
Sauce check: Golden, glossy mushrooms. Pasta: Tender with a slight bite.
Dish plated. Review the texture, sauce, and choices you made.
